description: Change of use, refurbishment and extension of the properties to accommodate a five screen cinema including two ancillary bars, a restaurant/cafe and associated facilities
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1-LO 101, 2-GA 101 B, 2-GA 102 D,  2-GA 103 D, 2-GA 104 C, 2-GA 105 C, 2-GA 106 C, 2-GA 201 E, 2-GA 202 B, 2-GA 301 E,  2-GA 302 D, 6-EX 101 A, 6-EX 102 A, 6-EX 103,
 6-EX 201, 6-EX 301B, 6-EX 302A, Design and Access Statement, Sustainability Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Energy Statement, Noise Impact Assessment, Planning and Sequential Assessment, received 07/05/13. Transport Statement received 13/05/13. Transport Addendum received 10/09/13.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted has commenced, a method 	statement and scheme of construction practice shall be submitted to and 	approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following 	matters:
(i)	any illumination of the site during construction
(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site
(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties
(iv)	considerate contractor scheme
(v)	boundary treatment for the construction site
(vi)	details of size and location of construction compound
The construction scheme so approved should be fully implemented prior to commencement of construction operations.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of 	facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles shall be 	submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and 	implemented in accordance with such approval prior to first occupation of 	any part of the development.

Condition : 6 - For each part of the development, no work shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 7 - No additional fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 0800 to 1800 Mondays to Saturdays, nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 10 - Prior to the development being brought into use a report shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority detailing how the provisions and conclusions of the Noise Impact Assessment have been met, specifically. This shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - Occupation/use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 12 - Occupation/first use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the restaurant/bar of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 13 - Details of the frontage proposed, including elevations, materials and sections shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing and approved prior to commencement of this part of this development. Installation of the proposed shopfront shall be completed prior to occupation.

Condition : 14 - 17.	Details of the measures proposed on the site to reduce the carbon emissions by 25% of the predicted energy requirements of the  development hereby approved shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing prior to commencement of development, and the development thereby approved shall be implemented accordingly. If the applicant is unable to reach this target clear reasons should be given for this and mitigation proposed.

Condition : 15 - 18.	No development shall take place until details of measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run off from the building and the conservation and re-use as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved in writing.

Condition : 16 - 19.	The uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:

	Cinema screens Sunday to Thursdays 08.00 - 23.45
Friday to Saturday 08.00 - 00.45
	Bars and restaurant Sunday to Thursday 08.00 - 23.20
`	Friday to Saturday 08.00 - 23.50
Terrace All week 08.00 - 22.30 (Fully vacated at this time).

Condition : 17 - 20.	The premises shall be used for D2 (with ancillary A1), A4, use classes only and for no other A use class purpose (including use class A5 Takeaway, either in part or as a whole unit) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 18 - 21.	No refuse collection shall take place outside the hours of 8am-6pm Monday to Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 19 - 22.	Dining or drinking shall not take place anywhere on the site except within the building, or on the terrace within the approved hours of operation of this facility. No dining is to take place on the pavement.

Condition : 20 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 21 - No building, structure, plant or other apparatus shall be erected, placed or fixed to any part of the roof or the external faces of the building other than the plant/equipment on the approved drawings.

Condition : 22 - No part of the development shall be brought into use until safe and secure cycle parking in accordance with the approved plans has been implemented. This shall be retained as such. In accordance with the approved Section 106 Deed, a feasibility study to investigate the potential to improve the provision of cycle parking to account for 10% of occupancy shall be submitted and approved by the Council in writing, should the monies secured not be used for CPZ expansion.

Condition : 23 - The site shall be operated in accordance with the approved travel plan. The Travel Plan includes details of implementation and monitoring and shall be implemented in accordance with these agreed details. The results of the implementation and monitoring shall be made available to the Local Planning Authority on request, together with any changes to the plan arising from those results.
